12 January 2004

## Circular to Licensed Corporations which are licensed solely for Types 4, 5, 6 and/or 9 regulated activities and subject to the specified licensing condition *

## Compliance with Section 56(3) of the Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules to Submit Financial Return

This circular is to remind the licensed corporations which are licensed solely for one or more of the following:

- (a) Type 4 regulated activity;
- (b) Type 5 regulated activity;
- (c) Type 6 regulated activity;
- (d) Type 9 regulated activity,

and  subject  to  the  specified  licensing  condition  that  the  transitional  period  provided under the Securities and Futures (Financial Resources) Rules ('the Rules') has expired on 30 September 2003.

From 1 October 2003, these licensed  corporations  shall  comply  with  the  Rules  which include, inter alia, the following new requirements:

- (a) the minimum liquid capital requirement of $100,000;
- (b) the  submission  of  financial  return  in  respect  of  June  and  December, respectively, no later than 3 weeks after the end of the period concerned.

We take this opportunity to remind you that your first semi-annual financial return is due for submission on 21 January 2004 .  A blank copy of the financial return in electronic format is available on the SFC's website.

Should you have any queries regarding the above, please contact your responsible case officer of the Intermediaries Supervision Department or Ms Lorraine Chan at 2842-7751 for assistance.

Intermediaries and Investment Products Securities and Futures Commission

* specified licensing condition requires that the licensed corporation shall not hold client assets.
